build: csc /nologo /target:exe /optimize+ /platform:anycpu /out:ChessReviewHost.exe /r:System.dll /r:System.Core.dll /r:System.Web.Extensions.dll ChessReviewHost.cs (in-box .NET Framework 4.8 compiler; also built on windows-latest CI)
note: No prebuilt helper is committed for 1.1.0 yet: it needs a Windows build, and the 1.1.0 source adds the 'scoring-v1' search protocol (fixed-node, restricted, exact-only searches with WDL). native/install.ps1 therefore compiles native/host/ChessReviewHost.cs locally with the in-box csc.exe. The release workflow builds ChessReviewHost.exe and records its hash here for the release zip. To commit a prebuilt binary, build it, place it next to this file and set sha256. Prebuilt helper: one stable binary (and hash) for all users, so antivirus reputation accumulates instead of resetting on every install.
